snapshot.text: State-run system financed through compulsory medical insurance (OMS) and budgets. In July 2026 the government approved a plan to implement its health development strategy to 2030; replacing imported medicines remains a stated priority.

priorities.title: Health strategy implementation plan
priorities.text: Prime Minister Mishustin approved the plan for implementing the health system development strategy.

priorities.title: Import substitution of medicines
priorities.text: Murashko says replacing imported medicines will stay a priority of healthcare policy.

priorities.title: High-tech care for rural residents
priorities.text: The ministry reports that high-tech medical care has become twice as accessible for rural residents.
